Failures run through the whole window (about 18:51 to 18:57) and show up in earlier 5-minute bins from 18:30, so the denial is persistent rather than a one-off. The other three functions show no errors in the window. The denial names the missing IAM action on the role's execution policy, so this is an IAM issue rather than a code or configuration one. I could not read the role policy or the IaC template with the available tools, so whether the grant was removed by a console change or a template edit is unconfirmed.
